name: ExampleHbA1cTested
title: Example: diabetes with an HbA1c test
description: An illustrative measure, not a CMS eCQM or HEDIS measure: adults 18 to 75 with diabetes who had an HbA1c result in the period.

criteria.expression: %subject.birthDate <= (%periodEnd - 18 years) and %subject.birthDate > (%periodEnd - 76 years) and entry.resource.ofType(Condition).where(code.coding.where((system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and code = '44054006') or (system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm' and code.startsWith('E11'))).exists()).exists()

entry.resource.ofType(Observation).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '4548-4').exists() and effective.ofType(dateTime) >= %periodStart and effective.ofType(dateTime) <= %periodEnd and value.exists()).exists()
